All are 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed with 'sha256-md:'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md: '**Priority:** Critical (inherited from Feature TC-9003, will be propagated to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md: '**Priority:** Critical — inherited from Feature TC-9003 and propagated to all created tasks. The Feature's priority is set (not "Undefined"), so propagation applies.' Additional fields include '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md: '**fixVersions:** RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9003, will be propagated to all created tasks — no `fixVersion scope` setting found in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both")'. summary-comment.md: '**fixVersions:** RHTPA 1.5.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9003 and propagated to all created tasks. The Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array, and no `fixVersion scope` setting was found in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, so the default scope of "both" applies (propagate to tasks).' Additional fields include '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists with '## Inherited Field Values' section containing: 'Priority: Critical — inherited from Feature TC-9003 and propagated to all created tasks' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9003 and propagated to all created tasks'. impact-map.md also has '## Priority and fixVersion Inheritance' section with both values documented.
